rules.rule: Only `Development` may be used to open a pull request into `main`.
Bump the MAJOR version only when the user explicitly asks, and use a breaking-change conventional commit when doing so.
Never bump the major version on your own initiative under any circumstances.
Do not create branch types other than phase work and bug fix branches (no `infra/`, `docs/`, `chore/` prefixes).
When the upstream repo lacks harness-required files, store those files in apps/<name>/files/.
Do not run the Broadleaf DemoSite with `java -jar`.
Do not run the Broadleaf DemoSite with `mvn spring-boot:run`.
When rebuilding images, rebuild the base image before the language images.
Do not rebuild the images after editing container.ts.
In the agent-skill repo, commit to the current long-running feature branch, not to main.
In the agent-skill repo, do not switch to or push main.
Only commit or push changes when explicitly asked to do so.
In the agent-skill repo, run git branch to confirm the current feature branch before committing.
When a preamble change seems warranted, suggest it and ask the user for explicit permission before making it.
For a test run, run all applications (`all`) rather than a single app.
Make changes to harness config (config.sh) and evaluation files (evaluation.ts, EVALUATION.md) without asking for permission.
Do not run the application, generate traffic, or stand up a collector or weaver while performing otel-verification.
Never commit META_APP_TOKEN, MB_KEY, or other secrets to git.
The autopost endpoint may be triggered from any external source by supplying the CRON_SECRET.
Treat the case-studies/aeneas/ folder as read-only and user-owned.
Treat case-studies/aeneas/ as read-only and do not modify it.
Do not edit, add, delete, rename, format, generate files in, stage, or commit files in the case-studies/aeneas/ folder.
Never recreate `docs/features.md`.
Never recreate `docs/wrinkles.md`.
Keep reports under `docs/`.
Only override the case-studies/aeneas/ read-only restriction for a task when an explicit later instruction names work inside that folder.
Write any new report, ledger, or measurement summary to the docs/reports/ directory.
Never recreate a root-level reports/ directory.
Before committing, ensure `./run_python_checks` passes, including jscpd and vulture.
Before any deploy, reset, chart test, test run beyond smoke or single reruns, or disruptive step on minikube or kees00, run the ledger check command for that environment.
Do not release or bypass the podiumd-minikube cluster-lock (.minikube-lock) or the kees00 lease podiumd-tests-lock.
Run ./run_python_checks right before each commit, after the last edit.
Check git diff --cached before committing.
Read the project memory from the memory directory in the repository (not from ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/) when working on this project.
Never merge a PR; the user merges every PR himself.
Do not run `gh pr merge`.
Do not delete the branch after merging or pushing.
Write new memory entries to the memory directory in the repository, not to ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/.
Do not declare a fix pass done or commit it before the beginner-review re-run has been completed.
For the Radiopedia repo, never invoke preview_start; use the mcp__Claude_in_Chrome__* tools to connect to the user's running dev server instead.
Before adding a glossary key to glossary.ts, run `node scripts/check-glossary-coverage.mjs`.
To translate a glossary entry, first run `node scripts/extract-glossary.mjs`, then run `gemini-translate.py glossary <term>`.
Apply translations only after the user approves them, either with a go-ahead or with specific overrides.
Before creating a new memory file, check whether an existing file already covers the same ground.
Obtain applicable authorization before running any new paid test.
A/B test image prompts before running a batch.
A/B test image models before running a batch.
Read bible/taste.md before any concept work.
Never start the Seedance step on an episode without King's go-ahead.
Never start the Seedance step on an episode without a cost estimate.
